# Noland

> Noland is a desktop client that turns Vast.ai marketplace hardware into a personal Linux gaming PC for direct game streaming.

Noland has no monthly platform subscription. Users bring their own Vast.ai account and API key, choose available hardware, and pay marketplace compute charges while the rented instance runs.

## Product

- Marketplace hardware spans NVIDIA RTX 20-series through RTX 50-series, subject to live availability.
- Typical marketplace machines may cost approximately $0.10–$0.40 per hour depending on configuration.
- Average provisioning takes approximately 10–15 minutes.
- Measured Noland networking overhead is approximately 8 ms above natural route latency, not total latency.
- Desktop clients target Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Game and launcher compatibility varies within the supported PC/Linux ecosystem.
